scope: Only compact the current-checkout copy of the complete legacy stdout restoration manifest. All original entries and qualifications remain verbatim in its immutable Git history. No scientific actual/execution/native/input source or successful conclusion changes.
restore: Read complete_manifest from its immutable commit or Git blob and check its bytes and SHA256. Then use every original entry and qualification exactly as declared there. Restore logs with git show source_log_restore_commit:base_path/relative_path. No scientific rerun.
